findings.title: Pagination creates a phantom page for exact multiples of the page size
findings.body: `totalPages` uses `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, so a group with exactly 50 members (or any exact multiple of `limit`) reports two pages. The Next control remains enabled, requests offset 50, and displays an empty member list. This also occurs after deleting the final member on a partially filled last page when the count becomes an exact multiple. Use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` (while preserving the zero-member special case) and clamp/reload the offset as needed.
